title: Barbello Primary School polling station 1 of 1 (Tiaty Constituency, Baringo County)

claim.sentence: the affidavit of Arnold Ochieng Oginga deals with this polling station at paragraph 17 and in the table at pages 8 to 13. According to the table, the agent's Form 34A shows Raila Odinga 381 and William Ruto 20, and the portal form shows Raila Odinga 381 and William Ruto 69. The affidavit gives the increase for William Ruto as 49 votes.
